display_value_interactively: display a value as an interactively foldable object in IPython with optional autovisualization
show_multiple_objects_inline: show a list of objects inline with rich display like python print but with treescope representations
register_as_default_renderer: register treescope as the default IPython renderer for objects without custom renderers
run_cell_with_autovisualization: run a cell with automatic visualization of arrays enabled via the %%autovisualize magic
setup_ipython_interactive_environment: set up IPython for interactive use with treescope including default renderer and magics
